title: An Ancient Tomb Chamber at Wa'r Abu es Safa, near Jerusalem
author: D. C. Baramki
location_note: Wa'r Abu es Safa, a rocky area 2 km west of Jerusalem; no map reference; placed by name. p. 169 inferred (unnumbered last text leaf before the next article on p. 170).
notes: Found during quarrying in May 1934: rock-cut chamber with stone door and kokhim on three sides, a bone niche, seven ossuaries (rosettes, one with a colonnaded structure), many 'candlestick' tear bottles, Roman lamps, beads, iron coffin nails. The modern quarrying is not coded.

features.subtype: rock-cut kokhim tomb with stone door, bone niche and ossuaries
features.period: first century BC or first century AD (glass and pottery)
